public_rationale: Hayabusa Research's October 25, 2026 assessment reports localized stress without establishing broad cross-industry contagion [e1]. Reuters' October 26 analysis, available October 27, describes a Chinese stock-market crash [e2]. These reports do not establish the broad AI investment and infrastructure collapse required to test the forecast, so it remains unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: A regional stock-market crash does not establish the contract's broader collapse condition.
The packet identifies no qualifying post-collapse asset cohort, practical hobbyist deployments, or comparable operating and completion costs.
The collapse threshold, cost baselines, and observation period are unspecified.
Lower GPU purchase prices would not alone establish lower operating costs.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: After the bubble bursts, leftover GPUs will not be useful to hobbyists or cheaper to run, and incomplete data centers will not be cheaper to finish.

statement.excerpt: These are not going to be useful for hobbyists, nor will they be cheaper to run, nor will incomplete data centers be cheaper to finish.

from_speaker: not going to be useful for hobbyists
nor will they be cheaper to run
nor will incomplete data centers be cheaper to finish
our_interpretation: The antecedent is a broad collapse in the AI investment and infrastructure market described in the post. An isolated company failure or regional stock decline does not automatically establish it.
The forecast concerns surplus NVIDIA data-center GPUs and unfinished data centers following that collapse.

Useful means practical hobbyist use. Running costs mean comparable operating expenses, excluding the hardware purchase price. Completion costs mean the remaining cost of finishing comparable projects.
No deadline or post-collapse observation period is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is established, documented disposition and use of the surplus infrastructure, comparable GPU operating expenses, and remaining construction costs support all three assertions. A short period without counterexamples cannot conclusively establish an indefinite negative.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, documented practical hobbyist use of the surplus GPUs, lower comparable operating expenses, or lower comparable completion costs falsifies the corresponding assertion.

evidence.explanation: The report describes a Chinese market bust, which prevents treating all collapse evidence as absent. It does not establish the broader infrastructure liquidation contemplated by the post.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Establish the relevant broad collapse and its date, then document practical hobbyist use of surplus GPUs and comparable operating and remaining construction costs. A verified post-collapse counterexample could falsify the corresponding assertion; support for all three would require broader evidence and a justified observation endpoint.
